description:
Bill of Materials (BOM) for Tiko, a compile-time dependency injection and event framework
        for Java 21+ (CI-tested on JDK 21, 25, 26 and 27). Tiko orchestrates, it doesn't bundle —
        direct access, compile-time safe, nothing wrapped. Its annotation processor validates the
        whole wiring graph at compile time (unresolved and ambiguous dependencies, cycles, scope
        violations) and generates plain Java wiring code you can read and step through. No
        reflection, no classpath scanning in your wiring.
        Core: constructor injection, SINGLETON / EVENT / PROTOTYPE scopes, @Produces factory
        methods for plugging in any library, lifecycle hooks, and an in-process event bus with
        declarative event chaining (@EventHandler, @EventTrigger).
        Import this BOM with scope "import" in dependencyManagement to align the versions of every
        Tiko module: tiko-api (annotations and interfaces), tiko-processor (compile-time annotation
        processor), tiko-runtime (container and event bus), tiko-config (YAML-backed typed
        configuration), tiko-test (JUnit 5 extension and test overrides), tiko-kafka and
        tiko-kafka-processor (Kafka transport with compile-time-validated @KafkaSource / @KafkaSink
        bridges), and tiko-mcp (MCP server exposing the compiled topology to AI coding agents).
        Documentation: https://github.com/tomas-samek/tiko-di
